stories.title: U.S. Agencies Warn Refrigeration Controller Attacks Could Cause Fires and Inventory Losses
stories.summary: U.S. government agencies have warned that threat actors are actively targeting industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems globally with an aim to cause service disruptions, fire hazards, and loss of inventory. "The actors may exploit vulnerabilities or weaknesses in unpatched or internet-accessible controllers to remotely alter settings and force units into continuous heating

stories.title: CISA Flags SonicWall SonicOS MFA Bypass Flaw Amid Reports of Possible Exploitation
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a high-severity vulnerability impacting SonicWall SonicOS to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports that it said may have been exploited in real-world attacks. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-19868 (CVSS score: 7.1 / 7.5), has been described as an authentication reinforcement

stories.title: Hackers Exploiting ‘SSHole’ Authentication Bypass in OpenSSH
stories.summary: The initial exploitation attempts are attributed to botnets and crypto miners, but other threat actors are expected to follow suit.

stories.title: LNbits Urges All Operators to Shut Down Their Bitcoin Lightning Wallet Servers Amid Attacks
stories.summary: Everyone running LNbits, a free, open-source Bitcoin Lightning wallet system, should shut down their servers now because of a wave of attacks, the project said yesterday. It has several security fixes to release and asked operators to be careful until they are out. stories.title: Ukraine dismantles crypto scam network that stole €4.3 million
stories.summary: Ukrainian law enforcement arrested four suspects in a case involving the theft of more than €4.3 million using a network of cryptocurrency investment scam call centers.

stories.title: Amplifon Americas Data Breach Impacts 1.3 Million
stories.summary: Hackers stole personal, health, and insurance information, including Social Security numbers, from the company’s internal systems.

stories.title: Over 3 Million People Hit by Frontline Education Data Breach
stories.summary: Frontline Education told Indiana regulators that its August data breach affected over 3 million school district staff and students.

stories.title: [NEU] [mittel] IBM QRadar SIEM (Log Source Management App): Mehrere Schwachstellen
stories.summary: Ein Angreifer kann mehrere Schwachstellen in IBM QRadar SIEM (Log Source Management App) ausnutzen, um einen Denial of Service Angriff durchzuführen und um Informationen offenzulegen.
